verses.ar: «وَتَصْنَعُ مَذْبَحًا لِإِيقَادِ ٱلْبَخُورِ. مِنْ خَشَبِ ٱلسَّنْطِ تَصْنَعُهُ.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make an altar to burn incense upon: [of] shittim wood shalt thou make it.
verses.web: “You shall make an altar to burn incense on. You shall make it of acacia wood.
verses.he: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ מִזְבֵּ֖חַ מִקְטַ֣ר קְטֹ֑רֶת עֲצֵ֥י שִׁטִּ֖ים תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתֹֽו׃

verses.ar: طُولُهُ ذِرَاعٌ وَعَرْضُهُ ذِرَاعٌ. مُرَبَّعًا يَكُونُ. وَٱرْتِفَاعُهُ ذِرَاعَانِ. مِنْهُ تَكُونُ قُرُونُهُ.
verses.kjv: A cubit [shall be] the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof; foursquare shall it be: and two cubits [shall be] the height thereof: the horns thereof [shall be] of the same.
verses.web: Its length shall be a cubit, and its width a cubit. It shall be square, and its height shall be two cubits. Its horns shall be of one piece with it.
verses.he: אַמָּ֨ה אָרְכֹּ֜ו וְאַמָּ֤ה רָחְבֹּו֙ רָב֣וּעַ יִהְיֶ֔ה וְאַמָּתַ֖יִם קֹמָתֹ֑ו מִמֶּ֖נּוּ קַרְנֹתָֽיו׃

verses.ar: وَتُغَشِّيهِ بِذَهَبٍ نَقِيٍّ: سَطْحَهُ وَحِيطَانَهُ حَوَالَيْهِ وَقُرُونَهُ. وَتَصْنَعُ لَهُ إِكْلِيلًا مِنْ ذَهَبٍ حَوَالَيْهِ.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, the top thereof, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns thereof; and thou shalt make unto it a crown of gold round about.
verses.web: You shall overlay it with pure gold, its top, its sides around it, and its horns; and you shall make a gold molding around it.
verses.he: וְצִפִּיתָ֨ אֹתֹ֜ו זָהָ֣ב טָהֹ֗ור אֶת־גַּגֹּ֧ו וְאֶת־קִירֹתָ֛יו סָבִ֖יב וְאֶת־קַרְנֹתָ֑יו וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ לֹּ֛ו זֵ֥ר זָהָ֖ב סָבִֽיב׃

verses.ar: وَتَصْنَعُ لَهُ حَلْقَتَيْنِ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ تَحْتَ إِكْلِيلِهِ عَلَى جَانِبَيْهِ. عَلَى ٱلْجَانِبَيْنِ تَصْنَعُهُمَا، لِتَكُونَا بَيْتَيْنِ لِعَصَوَيْنِ لِحَمْلِهِ بِهِمَا.
verses.kjv: And two golden rings shalt thou make to it under the crown of it, by the two corners thereof, upon the two sides of it shalt thou make [it;] and they shall be for places for the staves to bear it withal.
verses.web: You shall make two golden rings for it under its molding; on its two ribs, on its two sides you shall make them; and they shall be for places for poles with which to bear it.
verses.he: וּשְׁתֵּי֩ טַבְּעֹ֨ת זָהָ֜ב תַּֽעֲשֶׂה־לֹּ֣ו ׀ מִתַּ֣חַת לְזֵרֹ֗ו עַ֚ל שְׁתֵּ֣י צַלְעֹתָ֔יו תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה עַל־שְׁנֵ֣י צִדָּ֑יו וְהָיָה֙ לְבָתִּ֣ים לְבַדִּ֔ים לָשֵׂ֥את אֹתֹ֖ו בָּהֵֽמָּה׃

verses.ar: وَتَصْنَعُ ٱلْعَصَوَيْنِ مِنْ خَشَبِ ٱلسَّنْطِ وَتُغَشِّيهِمَا بِذَهَبٍ.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make the staves [of] shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.
verses.web: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.
verses.he: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ אֶת־הַבַּדִּ֖ים עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים וְצִפִּיתָ֥ אֹתָ֖ם זָהָֽב׃

verses.ar: وَتَجْعَلُهُ قُدَّامَ ٱلْحِجَابِ ٱلَّذِي أَمَامَ تَابُوتِ ٱلشَّهَادَةِ. قُدَّامَ ٱلْغِطَاءِ ٱلَّذِي عَلَى ٱلشَّهَادَةِ حَيْثُ أَجْتَمِعُ بِكَ.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt put it before the vail that [is] by the ark of the testimony, before the mercy seat that [is] over the testimony, where I will meet with thee.
verses.web: You shall put it before the veil that is by the ark of the covenant, before the mercy seat that is over the covenant, where I will meet with you.
verses.he: וְנָתַתָּ֤ה אֹתֹו֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הַפָּרֹ֔כֶת אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־אֲרֹ֣ן הָעֵדֻ֑ת לִפְנֵ֣י הַכַּפֹּ֗רֶת אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־הָ֣עֵדֻ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֛ר אִוָּעֵ֥ד לְךָ֖ שָֽׁמָּה׃

verses.ar: فَيُوقِدُ عَلَيْهِ هَارُونُ بَخُورًا عَطِرًا كُلَّ صَبَاحٍ، حِينَ يُصْلِحُ ٱلسُّرُجَ يُوقِدُهُ.
verses.kjv: And Aaron shall burn thereon sweet incense every morning: when he dresseth the lamps, he shall burn incense upon it.
verses.web: Aaron shall burn incense of sweet spices on it every morning. When he tends the lamps, he shall burn it.
verses.he: וְהִקְטִ֥יר עָלָ֛יו אַהֲרֹ֖ן קְטֹ֣רֶת סַמִּ֑ים בַּבֹּ֣קֶר בַּבֹּ֗קֶר בְּהֵיטִיבֹ֛ו אֶת־הַנֵּרֹ֖ת יַקְטִירֶֽנָּה׃

verses.ar: وَحِينَ يُصْعِدُ هَارُونُ ٱلسُّرُجَ فِي ٱلْعَشِيَّةِ يُوقِدُهُ. بَخُورًا دَائِمًا أَمَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ فِي أَجْيَالِكُمْ.
verses.kjv: And when Aaron lighteth the lamps at even, he shall burn incense upon it, a perpetual incense before the LORD throughout your generations.
verses.web: When Aaron lights the lamps at evening, he shall burn it, a perpetual incense before Yahweh throughout your generations.
verses.he: וּבְהַעֲלֹ֨ת אַהֲרֹ֧ן אֶת־הַנֵּרֹ֛ת בֵּ֥ין הָעֲרְבַּ֖יִם יַקְטִירֶ֑נָּה קְטֹ֧רֶת תָּמִ֛יד לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶֽם׃

verses.ar: لَا تُصْعِدُوا عَلَيْهِ بَخُورًا غَرِيبًا وَلَا مُحْرَقَةً أَوْ تَقْدِمَةً، وَلَا تَسْكُبُوا عَلَيْهِ سَكِيبًا.
verses.kjv: Ye shall offer no strange incense thereon, nor burnt sacrifice, nor meat offering; neither shall ye pour drink offering thereon.
verses.web: You shall offer no strange incense on it, nor burnt offering, nor meal offering; and you shall pour no drink offering on it.
verses.he: לֹא־תַעֲל֥וּ עָלָ֛יו קְטֹ֥רֶת זָרָ֖ה וְעֹלָ֣ה וּמִנְחָ֑ה וְנֵ֕סֶךְ לֹ֥א תִסְּכ֖וּ עָלָֽיו׃

verses.ar: وَيَصْنَعُ هَارُونُ كَفَّارَةً عَلَى قُرُونِهِ مَرَّةً فِي ٱلسَّنَةِ. مِنْ دَمِ ذَبِيحَةِ ٱلْخَطِيَّةِ ٱلَّتِي لِلْكَفَّارَةِ مَرَّةً فِي ٱلسَّنَةِ يَصْنَعُ كَفَّارَةً عَلَيْهِ فِي أَجْيَالِكُمْ. قُدْسُ أَقْدَاسٍ هُوَ لِلرَّبِّ».
verses.kjv: And Aaron shall make an atonement upon the horns of it once in a year with the blood of the sin offering of atonements: once in the year shall he make atonement upon it throughout your generations: it [is] most holy unto the LORD.
verses.web: Aaron shall make atonement on its horns once in the year; with the blood of the sin offering of atonement once in the year he shall make atonement for it throughout your generations. It is most holy to Yahweh.”
verses.he: וְכִפֶּ֤ר אַהֲרֹן֙ עַל־קַרְנֹתָ֔יו אַחַ֖ת בַּשָּׁנָ֑ה מִדַּ֞ם חַטַּ֣את הַכִּפֻּרִ֗ים אַחַ֤ת בַּשָּׁנָה֙ יְכַפֵּ֤ר עָלָיו֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם קֹֽדֶשׁ־קֽ͏ָדָשִׁ֥ים ה֖וּא לַיהוָֽה׃ פ

verses.ar: وَكَلَّمَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى قَائِلًا:
verses.kjv: ¶ And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.he: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

verses.ar: «إِذَا أَخَذْتَ كَمِّيَّةَ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ بِحَسَبِ ٱلْمَعْدُودِينَ مِنْهُمْ، يُعْطُونَ كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ فِدْيَةَ نَفْسِهِ لِلرَّبِّ عِنْدَمَا تَعُدُّهُمْ، لِئَلَّا يَصِيرَ فِيهِمْ وَبَأٌ عِنْدَمَا تَعُدُّهُمْ.
verses.kjv: When thou takest the sum of the children of Israel after their number, then shall they give every man a ransom for his soul unto the LORD, when thou numberest them; that there be no plague among them, when [thou] numberest them.
verses.web: “When you take a census of the children of Israel, according to those who are counted among them, then each man shall give a ransom for his soul to Yahweh when you count them, that there be no plague among them when you count them.
verses.he: כִּ֣י תִשָּׂ֞א אֶת־רֹ֥אשׁ בְּנֽ͏ֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ לִפְקֻדֵיהֶם֒ וְנָ֨תְנ֜וּ אִ֣ישׁ כֹּ֧פֶר נַפְשֹׁ֛ו לַיהוָ֖ה בִּפְקֹ֣ד אֹתָ֑ם וְלֹא־יִהְיֶ֥ה בָהֶ֛ם נֶ֖גֶף בִּפְקֹ֥ד אֹתָֽם׃

verses.ar: هَذَا مَا يُعْطِيهِ كُلُّ مَنِ ٱجْتَازَ إِلَى ٱلْمَعْدُودِينَ: نِصْفُ ٱلشَّاقِلِ بِشَاقِلِ ٱلْقُدْسِ. ٱلشَّاقِلُ هُوَ عِشْرُونَ جِيرَةً. نِصْفُ ٱلشَّاقِلِ تَقْدِمَةً لِلرَّبِّ.
verses.kjv: This they shall give, every one that passeth among them that are numbered, half a shekel after the shekel of the sanctuary: (a shekel [is] twenty gerahs:) an half shekel [shall be] the offering of the LORD.
verses.web: They shall give this, everyone who passes over to those who are counted, half a shekel according to the shekel of the sanctuary (the shekel is twenty gerahs); half a shekel for an offering to Yahweh.
verses.he: זֶ֣ה ׀ יִתְּנ֗וּ כָּל־הָעֹבֵר֙ עַל־הַפְּקֻדִ֔ים מַחֲצִ֥ית הַשֶּׁ֖קֶל בְּשֶׁ֣קֶל הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ עֶשְׂרִ֤ים גֵּרָה֙ הַשֶּׁ֔קֶל מַחֲצִ֣ית הַשֶּׁ֔קֶל תְּרוּמָ֖ה לֽ͏ַיהוָֽה׃

verses.ar: كُلُّ مَنِ ٱجْتَازَ إِلَى ٱلْمَعْدُودِينَ مِنِ ٱبْنِ عِشْرِينَ سَنَةً فَصَاعِدًا يُعْطِي تَقْدِمَةً لِلرَّبِّ.
verses.kjv: Every one that passeth among them that are numbered, from twenty years old and above, shall give an offering unto the LORD.
verses.web: Everyone who passes over to those who are counted, from twenty years old and upward, shall give the offering to Yahweh.
verses.he: כֹּ֗ל הָעֹבֵר֙ עַל־הַפְּקֻדִ֔ים מִבֶּ֛ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וָמָ֑עְלָה יִתֵּ֖ן תְּרוּמַ֥ת יְהוָֽה׃

verses.ar: اَلْغَنِيُّ لَا يُكَثِّرُ وَٱلْفَقِيرُ لَا يُقَلِّلُ عَنْ نِصْفِ ٱلشَّاقِلِ حِينَ تُعْطُونَ تَقْدِمَةَ ٱلرَّبِّ لِلتَّكْفِيرِ عَنْ نُفُوسِكُمْ.
verses.kjv: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less than half a shekel, when [they] give an offering unto the LORD, to make an atonement for your souls.
verses.web: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less, than the half shekel, when they give the offering of Yahweh, to make atonement for your souls.
verses.he: הֶֽעָשִׁ֣יר לֹֽא־יַרְבֶּ֗ה וְהַדַּל֙ לֹ֣א יַמְעִ֔יט מִֽמַּחֲצִ֖ית הַשָּׁ֑קֶל לָתֵת֙ אֶת־תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה לְכַפֵּ֖ר עַל־נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶֽם׃

verses.ar: وَتَأْخُذُ فِضَّةَ ٱلْكَفَّارَةِ مِنْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ، وَتَجْعَلُهَا لِخِدْمَةِ خَيْمَةِ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ. فَتَكُونُ لِبَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ تَذْكَارًا أَمَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ لِلتَّكْفِيرِ عَنْ نُفُوسِكُمْ».
verses.kjv: And thou shalt take the atonement money of the children of Israel, and shalt appoint it for the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; that it may be a memorial unto the children of Israel before the LORD, to make an atonement for your souls.
verses.web: You shall take the atonement money from the children of Israel, and shall appoint it for the service of the Tent of Meeting; that it may be a memorial for the children of Israel before Yahweh, to make atonement for your souls.”
verses.he: וְלָקַחְתָּ֞ אֶת־כֶּ֣סֶף הַכִּפֻּרִ֗ים מֵאֵת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְנָתַתָּ֣ אֹתֹ֔ו עַל־עֲבֹדַ֖ת אֹ֣הֶל מֹועֵ֑ד וְהָיָה֩ לִבְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל לְזִכָּרֹון֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה לְכַפֵּ֖ר עַל־נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶֽם׃ פ

verses.ar: وَكَلَّمْ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى قَائِلًا:
verses.kjv: ¶ And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.he: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

verses.ar: «وَتَصْنَعُ مِرْحَضَةً مِنْ نُحَاسٍ، وَقَاعِدَتَهَا مِنْ نُحَاسٍ، لِلِٱغْتِسَالِ. وَتَجْعَلُهَا بَيْنَ خَيْمَةِ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ وَٱلْمَذْبَحِ، وَتَجْعَلُ فِيهَا مَاءً.
verses.kjv: Thou shalt also make a laver [of] brass, and his foot [also of] brass, to wash [withal:] and thou shalt put it between the tabernacle of the congregation and the altar, and thou shalt put water therein.
verses.web: “You shall also make a basin of bronze, and its base of bronze, in which to wash. You shall put it between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and you shall put water in it.
verses.he: וְעָשִׂ֜יתָ כִּיֹּ֥ור נְחֹ֛שֶׁת וְכַנֹּ֥ו נְחֹ֖שֶׁת לְרָחְצָ֑ה וְנָתַתָּ֣ אֹתֹ֗ו בֵּֽין־אֹ֤הֶל מֹועֵד֙ וּבֵ֣ין הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וְנָתַתָּ֥ שָׁ֖מָּה מָֽיִם׃

verses.ar: فَيَغْسِلُ هَارُونُ وَبَنُوهُ أَيْدِيَهُمْ وَأَرْجُلَهُمْ مِنْهَا.
verses.kjv: For Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet thereat:
verses.web: Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet in it.
verses.he: וְרָחֲצ֛וּ אַהֲרֹ֥ן וּבָנָ֖יו מִמֶּ֑נּוּ אֶת־יְדֵיהֶ֖ם וְאֶת־רַגְלֵיהֶֽם׃

verses.ar: عِنْدَ دُخُولِهِمْ إِلَى خَيْمَةِ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ يَغْسِلُونَ بِمَاءٍ لِئَلَّا يَمُوتُوا، أَوْ عِنْدَ ٱقْتِرَابِهِمْ إِلَى ٱلْمَذْبَحِ لِلْخِدْمَةِ لِيُوقِدُوا وَقُودًا لِلرَّبِّ.
verses.kjv: When they go into the tabernacle of the congregation, they shall wash with water, that they die not; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn offering made by fire unto the LORD:
verses.web: When they go into the Tent of Meeting, they shall wash with water, that they don’t die; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn an offering made by fire to Yahweh.
verses.he: בְּבֹאָ֞ם אֶל־אֹ֧הֶל מֹועֵ֛ד יִרְחֲצוּ־מַ֖יִם וְלֹ֣א יָמֻ֑תוּ אֹ֣ו בְגִשְׁתָּ֤ם אֶל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ לְשָׁרֵ֔ת לְהַקְטִ֥יר אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַֽיהוָֽה׃

verses.ar: يَغْسِلُونَ أَيْدِيَهُمْ وَأَرْجُلَهُمْ لِئَلَّا يَمُوتُوا. وَيَكُونُ لَهُمْ فَرِيضَةً أَبَدِيَّةً لَهُ وَلِنَسْلِهِ فِي أَجْيَالِهِمْ».
verses.kjv: So they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they die not: and it shall be a statute for ever to them, [even] to him and to his seed throughout their generations.
verses.web: So they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they not die. This shall be a statute forever to them, even to him and to his descendants throughout their generations.”
verses.he: וְרָחֲצ֛וּ יְדֵיהֶ֥ם וְרַגְלֵיהֶ֖ם וְלֹ֣א יָמֻ֑תוּ וְהָיְתָ֨ה לָהֶ֧ם חָק־עֹולָ֛ם לֹ֥ו וּלְזַרְעֹ֖ו לְדֹרֹתָֽם׃ פ

verses.ar: وَكَلَّمَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى قَائِلًا:
verses.kjv: ¶ Moreover the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.web: Moreover Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.he: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

verses.ar: «وَأَنْتَ تَأْخُذُ لَكَ أَفْخَرَ ٱلْأَطْيَابِ: مُرًّا قَاطِرًا خَمْسَ مِئَةِ شَاقِلٍ، وَقِرْفَةً عَطِرَةً نِصْفَ ذَلِكَ: مِئَتَيْنِ وَخَمْسِينَ، وَقَصَبَ ٱلذَّرِيرَةِ مِئَتَيْنِ وَخَمْسِينَ،
verses.kjv: Take thou also unto thee principal spices, of pure myrrh five hundred [shekels], and of sweet cinnamon half so much, [even] two hundred and fifty [shekels], and of sweet calamus two hundred and fifty [shekels],
verses.web: “Also take fine spices: of liquid myrrh, five hundred shekels; and of fragrant cinnamon half as much, even two hundred and fifty; and of fragrant cane, two hundred and fifty;
verses.he: וְאַתָּ֣ה קַח־לְךָ֮ בְּשָׂמִ֣ים רֹאשׁ֒ מָר־דְּרֹור֙ חֲמֵ֣שׁ מֵאֹ֔ות וְקִנְּמָן־בֶּ֥שֶׂם מַחֲצִיתֹ֖ו חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים וּמָאתָ֑יִם וּקְנֵה־בֹ֖שֶׂם חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּמָאתָֽיִם׃

verses.ar: وَسَلِيخَةً خَمْسَ مِئَةٍ بِشَاقِلِ ٱلْقُدْسِ، وَمِنْ زَيْتِ ٱلزَّيْتُونِ هِينًا.
verses.kjv: And of cassia five hundred [shekels], after the shekel of the sanctuary, and of oil olive an hin:
verses.web: and of cassia five hundred, according to the shekel of the sanctuary; and a hin of olive oil.
verses.he: וְקִדָּ֕ה חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֹ֖ות בְּשֶׁ֣קֶל הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וְשֶׁ֥מֶן זַ֖יִת הִֽין׃

verses.ar: وَتَصْنَعُهُ دُهْنًا مُقَدَّسًا لِلْمَسْحَةِ. عِطْرَ عِطَارَةٍ صَنْعَةَ ٱلْعَطَّارِ. دُهْنًا مُقَدَّسًا لِلْمَسْحَةِ يَكُونُ.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make it an oil of holy ointment, an ointment compound after the art of the apothecary: it shall be an holy anointing oil.
verses.web: You shall make it into a holy anointing oil, a perfume compounded after the art of the perfumer: it shall be a holy anointing oil.
verses.he: וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ אֹתֹ֗ו שֶׁ֚מֶן מִשְׁחַת־קֹ֔דֶשׁ רֹ֥קַח מִרְקַ֖חַת מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה רֹקֵ֑חַ שֶׁ֥מֶן מִשְׁחַת־קֹ֖דֶשׁ יִהְיֶֽה׃

verses.ar: وَتَمْسَحُ بِهِ خَيْمَةَ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ، وَتَابُوتَ ٱلشَّهَادَةِ،
verses.kjv: And thou shalt anoint the tabernacle of the congregation therewith, and the ark of the testimony,
verses.web: You shall use it to anoint the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the covenant,
verses.he: וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֥ בֹ֖ו אֶת־אֹ֣הֶל מֹועֵ֑ד וְאֵ֖ת אֲרֹ֥ון הָעֵדֻֽת׃

verses.ar: وَٱلْمَائِدَةَ وَكُلَّ آنِيَتِهَا، وَٱلْمَنَارَةَ وَآنِيَتَهَا، وَمَذْبَحَ ٱلْبَخُورِ،
verses.kjv: And the table and all his vessels, and the candlestick and his vessels, and the altar of incense,
verses.web: the table and all its articles, the lamp stand and its accessories, the altar of incense,
verses.he: וְאֶת־הַשֻּׁלְחָן֙ וְאֶת־כָּל־כֵּלָ֔יו וְאֶת־הַמְּנֹרָ֖ה וְאֶת־כֵּלֶ֑יהָ וְאֵ֖ת מִזְבַּ֥ח הַקְּטֹֽרֶת׃

verses.ar: وَمَذْبَحَ ٱلْمُحْرَقَةِ وَكُلَّ آنِيَتِهِ، وَٱلْمِرْحَضَةَ وَقَاعِدَتَهَا.
verses.kjv: And the altar of burnt offering with all his vessels, and the laver and his foot.
verses.web: the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the basin with its base.
verses.he: וְאֶת־מִזְבַּ֥ח הָעֹלָ֖ה וְאֶת־כָּל־כֵּלָ֑יו וְאֶת־הַכִּיֹּ֖ר וְאֶת־כַּנֹּֽו׃

verses.ar: وَتُقَدِّسُهَا فَتَكُونُ قُدْسَ أَقْدَاسٍ. كُلُّ مَا مَسَّهَا يَكُونُ مُقَدَّسًا.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt sanctify them, that they may be most holy: whatsoever toucheth them shall be holy.
verses.web: You shall sanctify them, that they may be most holy. Whatever touches them shall be holy.
verses.he: וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֣ אֹתָ֔ם וְהָי֖וּ קֹ֣דֶשׁ קֽ͏ָדָשִׁ֑ים כָּל־הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בָּהֶ֖ם יִקְדָּֽשׁ׃

verses.ar: وَتَمْسَحُ هَارُونَ وَبَنِيهِ وَتُقَدِّسُهُمْ لِيَكْهَنُوا لِي.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt anoint Aaron and his sons, and consecrate them, that [they] may minister unto me in the priest’s office.
verses.web: You shall anoint Aaron and his sons, and sanctify them, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office.
verses.he: וְאֶת־אַהֲרֹ֥ן וְאֶת־בָּנָ֖יו תִּמְשָׁ֑ח וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם לְכַהֵ֥ן לִֽי׃

verses.ar: وَتُكَلِّمُ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ قَائِلًا: يَكُونُ هَذَا لِي دُهْنًا مُقَدَّسًا لِلْمَسْحَةِ فِي أَجْيَالِكُمْ.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, This shall be an holy anointing oil unto me throughout your generations.
verses.web: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘This shall be a holy anointing oil to me throughout your generations.
verses.he: וְאֶל־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל תְּדַבֵּ֣ר לֵאמֹ֑ר שֶׁ֠מֶן מִשְׁחַת־קֹ֨דֶשׁ יִהְיֶ֥ה זֶ֛ה לִ֖י לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶֽם׃

verses.ar: عَلَى جَسَدِ إِنْسَانٍ لَا يُسْكَبُ، وَعَلَى مَقَادِيرِهِ لَا تَصْنَعُوا مِثْلَهُ. مُقَدَّسٌ هُوَ، وَيَكُونُ مُقَدَّسًا عِنْدَكُمْ.
verses.kjv: Upon man’s flesh shall it not be poured, neither shall ye make [any other] like it, after the composition of it: it [is] holy, [and] it shall be holy unto you.
verses.web: It shall not be poured on man’s flesh, and do not make any like it, according to its composition. It is holy. It shall be holy to you.
verses.he: עַל־בְּשַׂ֤ר אָדָם֙ לֹ֣א יִיסָ֔ךְ וּבְמַ֨תְכֻּנְתֹּ֔ו לֹ֥א תַעֲשׂ֖וּ כָּמֹ֑הוּ קֹ֣דֶשׁ ה֔וּא קֹ֖דֶשׁ יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶֽם׃

verses.ar: كُلُّ مَنْ رَكَّبَ مِثْلَهُ وَمَنْ جَعَلَ مِنْهُ عَلَى أَجْنَبِيٍّ يُقْطَعُ مِنْ شَعْبِهِ».
verses.kjv: Whosoever compoundeth [any] like it, or whosoever putteth [any] of it upon a stranger, shall even be cut off from his people.
verses.web: Whoever compounds any like it, or whoever puts any of it on a stranger, he shall be cut off from his people.’”
verses.he: אִ֚ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִרְקַ֣ח כָּמֹ֔הוּ וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר יִתֵּ֛ן מִמֶּ֖נּוּ עַל־זָ֑ר וְנִכְרַ֖ת מֵעַמָּֽיו׃ ס

verses.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلرَّبُّ لِمُوسَى: «خُذْ لَكَ أَعْطَارًا: مَيْعَةً وَأَظْفَارًا وَقِنَّةً عَطِرَةً وَلُبَانًا نَقِيًّا. تَكُونُ أَجْزَاءً مُتَسَاوِيَةً،
verses.kjv: ¶ And the LORD said unto Moses, Take unto thee sweet spices, stacte, and onycha, and galbanum; [these] sweet spices with pure frankincense: of each shall there be a like [weight:]
verses.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “Take to yourself sweet spices, gum resin, onycha, and galbanum: sweet spices with pure frankincense. There shall be an equal weight of each.
verses.he: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֜ה קַח־לְךָ֣ סַמִּ֗ים נָטָ֤ף ׀ וּשְׁחֵ֙לֶת֙ וְחֶלְבְּנָ֔ה סַמִּ֖ים וּלְבֹנָ֣ה זַכָּ֑ה בַּ֥ד בְּבַ֖ד יִהְיֶֽה׃

verses.ar: فَتَصْنَعُهَا بَخُورًا عَطِرًا صَنْعَةَ ٱلْعَطَّارِ، مُمَلَّحًا نَقِيًّا مُقَدَّسًا.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make it a perfume, a confection after the art of the apothecary, tempered together, pure [and] holy:
verses.web: You shall make incense of it, a perfume after the art of the perfumer, seasoned with salt, pure and holy.
verses.he: וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ אֹתָהּ֙ קְטֹ֔רֶת רֹ֖קַח מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה רֹוקֵ֑חַ מְמֻלָּ֖ח טָהֹ֥ור קֹֽדֶשׁ׃

verses.ar: وَتَسْحَقُ مِنْهُ نَاعِمًا، وَتَجْعَلُ مِنْهُ قُدَّامَ ٱلشَّهَادَةِ فِي خَيْمَةِ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ حَيْثُ أَجْتَمِعُ بِكَ. قُدْسَ أَقْدَاسٍ يَكُونُ عِنْدَكُمْ.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt beat [some] of it very small, and put of it before the testimony in the tabernacle of the congregation, where I will meet with thee: it shall be unto you most holy.
verses.web: You shall beat some of it very small, and put some of it before the covenant in the Tent of Meeting, where I will meet with you. It shall be to you most holy.
verses.he: וְשָֽׁחַקְתָּ֣ מִמֶּנָּה֮ הָדֵק֒ וְנָתַתָּ֨ה מִמֶּ֜נָּה לִפְנֵ֤י הָעֵדֻת֙ בְּאֹ֣הֶל מֹועֵ֔ד אֲשֶׁ֛ר אִוָּעֵ֥ד לְךָ֖ שָׁ֑מָּה קֹ֥דֶשׁ קֽ͏ָדָשִׁ֖ים תִּהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶֽם׃

verses.ar: وَٱلْبَخُورُ ٱلَّذِي تَصْنَعُهُ عَلَى مَقَادِيرِهِ لَا تَصْنَعُوا لِأَنْفُسِكُمْ. يَكُونُ عِنْدَكَ مُقَدَّسًا لِلرَّبِّ.
verses.kjv: And [as for] the perfume which thou shalt make, ye shall not make to yourselves according to the composition thereof: it shall be unto thee holy for the LORD.
verses.web: You shall not make this incense, according to its composition, for yourselves: it shall be to you holy for Yahweh.
verses.he: וְהַקְּטֹ֙רֶת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה בְּמַ֨תְכֻּנְתָּ֔הּ לֹ֥א תַעֲשׂ֖וּ לָכֶ֑ם קֹ֛דֶשׁ תִּהְיֶ֥ה לְךָ֖ לַיהוָֽה׃

verses.ar: كُلُّ مَنْ صَنَعَ مِثْلَهُ لِيَشُمَّهُ يُقْطَعُ مِنْ شَعْبِهِ».
verses.kjv: Whosoever shall make like unto that, to smell thereto, shall even be cut off from his people.
verses.web: Whoever shall make any like that, to smell of it, he shall be cut off from his people.”
verses.he: אִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה כָמֹ֖והָ לְהָרִ֣יחַ בָּ֑הּ וְנִכְרַ֖ת מֵעַמָּֽיו׃ ס
